label: SAMPLE SEED — fictional notes written for this prototype. Not visitor posts. Do not present them as real.

entries.text: I never said this without a joke in front of it. You showing up, even late, even loud, was the part I counted on. I'm saying it plain: thank you for staying.
The kettle still clicks the way you set it. I laugh at the wrong moment on purpose now. If you can hear one line: I kept your terrible puns, and I love you.
有些话我当面总是说不出口。你每天下班还来接我的那些晚上，我都记得。谢谢你一直当我的超人。
院子里的桂花开了。我想告诉你，我过得还好，也会记得把话说完。想你。
My dad's real cape is the car that waits after practice.

alt.en: Crayon drawing of a smiling dad in sunglasses and a red cape under a yellow sun.
alt.zh: 蜡笔图：戴墨镜、披红披风的爸爸，站在黄太阳下面。

entries.text: The beach is still too bright without your hat in the picture. I took the long walk and told you about my week. You would have made a speech. I love you.
周末的煎蛋，总是做成笑脸。

alt.en: Crayon drawing of a smiley fried egg in a pan, next to a small waving dad.
alt.zh: 蜡笔图：平底锅里一张笑脸煎蛋，旁边一个小爸爸在挥手。

entries.text: I used to be embarrassed when you sang too loud at school. I hear that song in my head on hard days. Thank you for being impossible to ignore.
你的工具箱还在阳台。我会修那盏灯，虽然肯定没有你修得好。这次我想先说我爱你。
He claps before I even stand up on the skates.

alt.en: Crayon drawing of a tall dad and a child holding hands on a patch of ice.
alt.zh: 蜡笔图：高高的爸爸和孩子在一小片冰上牵着手。

entries.text: The match was on and nobody argued with the referee. It felt wrong. I saved you the last biscuit anyway. I miss you.
爸爸变成了那颗最亮的星。我还会朝它挥手。

alt.en: Crayon drawing of a child waving up at a large gold star above a small house.
alt.zh: 蜡笔图：孩子对着小屋上方一颗很大的金星挥手。
